displayName: ORIGIN (Nexus 01) RPO 运动策略契约

provenance.note: Contract declared from the public RPO tutorial (forum.d-robotics.cc/t/topic/35763, 2026-09-28): single-frame observation 78D = gyro(3) + projected_gravity(3) + command(3) + joint-position offset(23) + joint-velocity(23) + last action(23), stacked 10 frames oldest-first into a 780D policy input, 23D joint-position-offset actions. Safety numbers are template values pending validation against real hardware; this robot has no board runtime on this platform, so artifacts stay training/sim2sim evidence and never deployable.
